input.resize: YOLO letterbox; retain scale and padding for source-pixel restoration

output.format: YOLOv8 detect: cx, cy, w, h, class0 score

failure_policy: zero or low-confidence detections return absent/unknown and must not trigger clicks
l2_contract: L2 receives crops derived from the detected first row. It identifies individual Buff icons and state; L1 never decides mounted, cooldown, or skill identity.
derived_capacity: refine icon pitch from the detected row, then scan at most 6 columns by 5 rows; do not train or click an invisible capacity boundary
